author: CatBangsviaSkype
body:
IGN: My current in-game name is WantTheJaffa, however when I was banned I was called DMS_Strike. 

Reason: Back in November 1st, I was caught for Kill Aura.

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: I didn't want to appeal a day later, a week later if not a few months later. I wanted to leave appealing for at least 6 months. It's coming up to the ten month mark from when I was banned so I wanted to make an appeal to at least tell Staff of Avicus that I have changed.

Before I start, if you do look on Badlion for recent punishment history, I may as well admit it now. In April I was caught by GCheat for Spider. Quite an un-useful hack to use on a 1v1 server, however I caught. That's all that mattered. Not that I used a stupid hack, but because I used a client on their server which is of course punishable. 

Back before I actually practiced PvP I was inpatient. Then again I'm not the greatest at pvp, but it's the best I can do at the moment, however, I used to hack on your server because jealousy overruled me. I wanted to be a great pvper like others on the server, so what did I do? I hacked, I used a client on your server which I got luckily got banned for. Furthermore I say 'Luckily' like it's a good thing. To me it is, I've never really had the patience to just practice! Yet for the past 5-6 months on Kohi/Hypixel (No advertising intended) I've practiced my PvP. Obviously what I did on your server was bannable, but that's not the main point, I ruined other player's experiences which can also cause trouble outside of the game which I didn't intend to happen.

In addition, the term hacking to me I've tried to wipe from myself. Cheating isn't the way to go, obviously in some servers you're allowed to hack, but for the majority you're not. On here for example, I chose to hack because I thought I was invincible! Yet no, I got caught by a well trained staff member. 

I left appealing this long because I needed to find myself in gaming, not to sound cringey but it was hard for me to find my ground. So I focused on building for clients, I served my purpose and I enjoyed it! Yet when I went to apply for a server and don't get me wrong, I was Trial Senior Moderator, I served my purpose there too, helped others, gave interviews to others but I found myself in an awkward position. I was giving hacking training to others when yet I used to be a hacker. I had the regret not just on here, but other servers too. So I resigned from my position. Two months on from then, I'm here. Appealing an infraction, which may not even be accepted.

I'd just like to thank everyone who is reading this, I understand this takes time and effort out of your day to read through appeals of players who took their decision to hack, and to ruin experiences, so I'm grateful for your time and your effort. Whether my appeal gets accepted is another story. I had fun playing here back in the day, hopefully I can be accepted to have one more chance, I'd fully appreciate it. Anyway, take care.

Kind Regards,

Jaffa/DMS
